explication: Dub is an open-source link-attribution platform spanning short-link management, conversion analytics, and affiliate programs. A user manages links or programs in the workspace dashboard; links generate click and conversion attribution, while affiliate workflows support partner enrollment, earnings, and payouts. The repository also includes an embedded referrals experience, a public program marketplace, and administrative operations. The graph preserves those documented product areas and the sampled UI composition links; many backend routes appear in the tree but their internal calls were not sampled, so those connections are omitted.
